title: Weekend Update- Rudy Giuliani on Trump’s Election Lawsuits
text: President Trump said he's moving forward with legal challenges to vote counts across the country. Here to comment is the man leading the charge, his personal lawyer, Rudy Giuliani. Whoa, whoa, whoa, look at that. If it ain't de Blasio and Dinkins. Hello. Hi. Yeah, I get it. Hi, Rudy. Thanks so much for being here. Yeah, good times. Hey, did you see my press conference today? It was at the Four Seasons. Fancy. Yeah, it sounds fancy, but it was at a landscaping company called Four Seasons. Was that a mistake? What? No. Anyway, I'm glad I made it to this show on time, because first I went to 30 Rocks. That's a granite quarry in New Rochelle. What a night. Okay, Rudy, so the president has said he will be mounting some legal challenges to a lot of the votes out there. What is your strategy to do that? Okay, listen to me. I got tons of strategies, okay? First, we're going to throw out bogus mail-in ballots. Colin, these ballots, they could be coming from Mars. Right. Yes. No, that is a real thing that you really did say. That's right. So we're going to demand that we look at all the names. If the name is Meepthorpe Xandar and the address is Mars, we're going to get those ballots thrown out, okay? Plus, plus, we got no idea if they really are ballots. They might be tortillas. We're going to eat them and see if they're tortillas. If my butt blows after I eat it, you know that's a tortilla. That sounds like a great process. So your team... Now, your team, they want to get more poll watchers in there to make sure the counting is happening correctly. Exactly. So we're going to go in there. We're going to get our poll watchers so close. Okay. We're going to get this. See, this is legally closed. See, this is legally closed. Okay. Nuts on back. That's where a poll watcher ought to be. That's right. Why are they so hot? He ordered nuts. Aside from the counts, what actual legal recourse do you have to challenge these results? Okay, listen to this. In Michigan, okay, we demanded a recount. In Wisconsin, we have demanded a decount. We counted. It's called Baxi's and Novati. We got safety in Arizona. And in Georgia, opposite day. Plus, we're going to demand that I do the recount personally, and our silver bullet is, I can't count very high. Also, also, we're suing all the states we lost. You're suing all the states for what? I don't know, child support, manslaughter. I don't know. What? Rudy, Rudy, I got to say, it just sounds like Trump got fewer votes, which is what the pollsters predicted. Okay, okay. The pollsters were all lying. Pollsters get paid to lie to people. They're always saying, like, hey, baby, I'm Cinnamon, but my real name is Britney. Don't tell them I told you. And then you find out her name ain't Britney. I'm sorry, are you talking about strippers? Yeah, strippers, pollsters. What do you call them? I call them, look, I know it's hard for you to talk about this, but you lost, so what is your plan? Rudy, what is your plan next, just, like, for yourself? Listen to me. I will be fine. I always land on my feet upside down from the ceiling. I will move back to the city that made me. Hey, New York. Daddy's home. You miss me? It's that famous New York lettuce. God, I love this town. Anyway, I got to go. I'm off to the peninsula. Oh, the peninsula, the hotel? No, the Yucatan. You never saw me. Rudy Giuliani, everyone. Taxi! Weekend Update. I'm Colin Jost. I'm Michael Che. Good night.
